integrity: Closed case classification, symbolic polynomial identities, complete bounded exact-integer certificate, and supplementary reproducibility program. No independent validation or publication claim.
scientific_limitations: The sharp ordinary phase cutoff is limited to crown graphs. The positive cases 2 through 12 are verified by an explicit complete finite integer certificate; infinite negative cases and strict unimodality on the positive support have symbolic proofs. Earlier total-domination identity is credited. Brown-Tufts 2014 full text was unavailable, so historical priority is bounded; no independent audit was performed.
title: A sharp log-concavity cutoff for domination polynomials of crown graphs
